title: Build the iHRIS-themed harness site
description: Generates the static site published at litlfred.github.io/ihris/: a landing board from ihris.json and each instance's declaration, and a page per package and per form class laid out as the accepted wireframe H2. Themed with src/site/theme/ihris-classic.json. All links are relative. --check-links fails on any internal link that does not resolve.
